    city="St. Louis",
    checkin_date=["August 3, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["August 13, 2025"],
    num_people=4,
    budget=40,
    stars=[2],
    pool_present=True,

    city="St. Louis",
    type=["Social"]
)

# Save attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions", value=attractions_result)

# Find nearest attractions based on hotels
nearest_result = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels_result,
    attractions=attractions_result,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_results", value=nearest_result)
